question: What is the meaning of recycled percentage in relation to end of life scenario?
description: The recycled percentage in relation to the end of life scenario refers to the proportion of materials that are recovered and reused or recycled at the end of a building's life cycle. This percentage is a measure of the building's circularity, indicating how much of the materials used in construction can be returned to pure-type material cycles, rather than ending up as waste. A higher recycled percentage suggests a more sustainable and circular approach to construction, as it implies a greater emphasis on material recovery and reuse.
